adopter_lexicon: 企业交通与接驳运营角色
社区、无障碍与人工服务角色
维护、数据保护与独立复核角色

adopter_lexicon_evidence.交通与属地管理角色: The package-local responsibility contract names this role as the owner of approvals, right-of-way boundaries, public safety and traffic-impact interfaces.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.企业交通与接驳运营角色: The package-local responsibility contract names this role as the owner of grouped demand versions, schedules, loading windows, cost and on-site guidance.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.社区、无障碍与人工服务角色: The package-local responsibility contract names this role as the owner of public-route continuity, alternatives, redress and low-digital-capacity access.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.维护、数据保护与独立复核角色: The package-local responsibility contract names this role as the owner of asset state, privacy, evidence retention and independent review.

adoption.scope_zh: 只采用本包已公开的活动链、人工替代、责任角色和阶段门字段做互操作对照；不采用外部包的叙事、几何或数据，不新增仓库硬门禁、正式评分项、服务覆盖或现场成效主张。
adoption.scope_en: This maps already-public activity-chain, human-alternative, role and phase-gate fields for interoperability only. It adopts no external package narrative, geometry or data, and adds no repository hard gate, formal score item, service coverage or field-outcome claim.

ai_off_path.zh: 纸面导向、电话入口、有人服务台和公开公交信息可独立完成同一出门与选择任务。
ai_off_path.en: Paper wayfinding, telephone entry, a staffed desk and public-transport information can independently complete the leaving-and-choice task.

ai_off_path.zh: 固定班次、纸面时刻表、步行替代和人工指路不依赖账号、网络或模型。
ai_off_path.en: Fixed services, a paper timetable, a walking alternative and staffed wayfinding do not depend on an account, network or model.

ai_off_path.zh: 人工交通台账、现场指挥、公开路缘状态和固定公共路线保持可用，不把企业服务当成公共路线替代。
ai_off_path.en: A staffed transport ledger, on-site direction, public curb status and a fixed public route remain available; enterprise service is not a substitute for the public route.
